input.quote: Any writing or work of authorship created by M&I in the course of performing the Services under this Agreement, even if paid for by Customer, shall be the property of M&I ("Developed Software").
input.rationale: Customer Data is protected (§ 17.1 makes us sole and exclusive owner and § 17.4 restricts M&I's use of our Confidential Information to the purposes contemplated by the Agreement), so that element is already met and no Vendor exploitation right over Customer Data exists. The deviation is custom development: § 10.4 vests in M&I every work of authorship created in performing the Services even if paid for by Customer, permits resale to other M&I customers, and gives us only a partial refund/credit, while § 17.2 confines us to Term-only use. We therefore lack any perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify or sublicense work we fund, failing the fallback. We target the fallback rather than reversing ownership to preferred, since assignment would require rewriting M&I's ownership, resale and refund machinery. The cure inserts a numbered § 10.5 licence and a five-word conforming carve-out in § 17.2, so the cross-reference resolves to an actual clause number and no unrelated commercial language (including the refund/credit mechanic and the confidentiality obligations) is altered.

proposal.summary: Add a numbered § 10.5 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Developed Software, and conform § 17.2.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.4 vests in M&I every work of authorship "even if paid for by Customer" and § 17.2 limits us to Term-only use, so we have no lasting rights in custom work we fund. Consistent with our fallback position we leave M&I's ownership of its programs and know-how intact but add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence in new Section 10.5 to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for our business, and conform § 17.2 to that licence.

ops.text: 10.5 License to Developed Software. M&I grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for Customer's business.

ops.oldText: Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data.
ops.newText: Except as provided in Section 10.5, Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data.
